articles.title: El-Sayed Edges Out Stevens in Michigan, Setting Up High-Stakes Senate Battle
articles.summary: Progressive Dr. Abdul El-Sayed narrowly defeated Rep. Haley Stevens in Michigan's Democratic Senate primary. He'll now face GOP's Mike Rogers in a crucial race for Senate control.

articles.title: LIV Golf Lands Mystery Investor, Players to Become Majority Owners
articles.summary: LIV Golf has secured an unnamed lead investor to replace Saudi Arabia's PIF, which pulled its $5 billion funding. The deal will make players majority equity holders, a first in major sports.

articles.title: Michigan Primary Shocker: Progressive El-Sayed Clinches Senate Nomination
articles.summary: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan's Democratic Senate primary, defeating establishment-backed Haley Stevens. He campaigned on Medicare for All and criticized big money in politics. The race saw $52 million in outside spending, a staggering sum.
